# renewal-month-anchor

行为约定：
next_renewal(day) takes a datetime.date and returns a date in the next calendar month with the same day-of-month, clamped to that month's last day. December rolls into January of the next year. Leap years follow the Gregorian calendar.

运行：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
